newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: Costa Rica Fedecoop fire caused little coffee loss.
newsitem.headline: Costa Rica Fedecoop fire caused little coffee loss.

text.p: A fire two weeks ago in a warehouse of Costa Rica's Fedecoop (Federacion de Cooperativas de Caficultores) caused only minor damage and minimal bean losses, a Fedecoop spokesman said.
"There was damage to the building of the production center, such as the roof, but the coffee losses were minimal," Ignacio Perez, the deputy manager of Fedecoop, told Reuters.

The fire was in Fedecoop's San Joaquin de Flores warehouse around nine miles from San Jose. The warehouse, with a capacity to hold 60,000 60-kg bags, only had around 500 bags inside at the time of the blaze.
Perez said given the official fire report was not fully ready, he could not give an exact figure for the amount of coffee lost.
